name: Federates Via
description: A GitHub repository federates into AWS through an IAM OIDC provider whose URL is the canonical github.com Actions issuer (token.actions.githubusercontent.com). Chains with the AWS-side FEDERATES_INTO edge: repo FEDERATES_VIA oidc_provider FEDERATES_INTO deploy_role. Resolved during the enrichment phase via the github_grid_link_manifest (structural constant rule). Derived link — not hotlink-backed.

link_rule.description: Derived-link provenance: the name of the grid-link manifest rule that emitted this edge (WHICH rule matched). Same shape as identity_core's TRUSTS_ISSUER — the enrichment engine's uniform provenance pair.

matched_value.description: Derived-link provenance: the exact value the rule matched on — WHAT the derivation keyed on.
